label: LORIOT → Aloxy Core
info:
Real sensors: LORIOT WebSocket output -> Aloxy Core /core/calculate/lns/loriot.
Core then pushes to /aloxy as usual (Modbus + Vercel).
URL with token comes from the LORIOT_WS_URL env var on the node-red container.

name: Real sensor uplinks from LORIOT (Pi dials out, so no public address needed)
uplinks → Core request
